headline: 3 Reasons to Avoid PANW and 1 Stock to Buy Instead
summary: The past six months have been a windfall for Palo Alto Networks’s shareholders. The company’s stock price has jumped 82.4%, hitting $322.75 per share. This was partly due to its solid quarterly results, and the run-up might have investors contemplating their next move.

headline: 'Tech Titan' Arora spearheads $1bn shot at NBA's London basketball team
summary: The US technology billionaire who led the acquisition of English cricket's most lucrative Hundred franchise is in talks to buy London's new NBA Europe team.  Sky News has learnt that Nikesh Arora, chief executive of the New York-listed cybersecurity firm Palo Alto Networks, is on a list of bidders being considered to acquire the latest addition to the capital's sports line-up.  Mr Arora last year assembled a group which instantly became known as the 'Tech Titans' when it bought a 49% stake in the Lords-based London Spirit Hundred team.
